scope: Public current contracts, feature IDs and delivery. Earlier verbose snapshots remain in Git history.

definition.BUILT: Executable source exists for the bounded recorded contract; native script/respondent acceptance is separate.
definition.PARTIAL: Executable source exists with the listed public scope unfinished.
definition.GENERIC_ONLY: Generic recorded-profile execution only; no current operation has this category.

delivery_reconciliation.counting_rule: The53 public baseline feature IDs are delivered; survey-completion-message-redirect is the one prepared addition. Neither record delivery nor equal-weight operation closure estimates effort or native acceptance.
